ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the medial regions with a high-intensity (white) distribution of approximately 35% concentrated on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, high-contrast contiguous white mottling and circular rings localized in the outer 1/3 of both the left and right lobes; solid low-intensity black pixels dominate the proximal area near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and high vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve through the mid-lobe and terminating at sharp, jagged tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of localized white circular pixel rings (barnacle scars) distributed across both ventral surfaces, with peak density on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the lower left lobe and near the central leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma including circular barnacle scarring and parallel linear abrasions consistent with odontocete rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe erosion and irregular pixel loss along the extreme distal margins of both fluke lobes.
